CSRF_FAILED: The page has expired. Refresh and try again
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{retry_after_seconds}} seconds
INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again later
EMAIL_CODE_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Request a new one
EMAIL_CODE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one
EMAIL_CODE_COOLDOWN: Sent too often. Try again in {{retry_after_seconds}} seconds
USERNAME_INVALID: The address name doesn't meet the rules: {{rule_text}}
USERNAME_RESERVED: This name is reserved. Pick another
NICKNAME_INVALID: The display name must be 1–{{max}} characters and can't contain line breaks or other special characters
PASSWORD_WEAK: The password must be at least {{min_length}} characters and contain both letters and digits
INVITE_CODE_REQUIRED: An invite code is required to sign up
INVITE_CODE_INVALID: The invite code is invalid, used up or expired
INVITE_CODE_LIMIT_REACHED: At most {{max}} invite codes can be kept at once. Revoke unused ones first
RENEWAL_CODE_INVALID: The renewal code is invalid, used up or expired
RENEWAL_CODE_ALREADY_REDEEMED: You've already redeemed this renewal code
MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRED: Membership expired. Please renew on the Looklook website first
DEVICE_ALREADY_LOGGED_IN: This account is already signed in on "{{device_name}}"
DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED: Already signed in on {{max}} computers, the limit. Sign one out on the Looklook website first
DEVICE_OFFLINE: The computer is offline. Make sure it's on and running Looklook
CLIENT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This Looklook version is too old. Please update to {{latest_version}} first
TIMESTAMP_SKEW: Your computer's clock is too far off. Correct it and try again
KEY_REVOKED: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Please sign in again
KEY_ROTATION_NOT_FOUND: The operation expired. Please try again
TUNNEL_LIMIT_REACHED: At most {{max}} local pages can be added
TUNNEL_PORT_INVALID: The number must be between 1 and 65535
TUNNEL_PORT_DUPLICATE: This number has already been added
SHARE_USER_NOT_FOUND: No Looklook account with the username {{username}}. Ask them to check their username.
SHARE_SELF: You can't share with yourself; you can already open it after signing in.
SHARE_LIMIT_REACHED: A page can be shared with at most {{max}} people at a time.
RELAY_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED: The service is busy. Please try again later

rule.charset: may only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
rule.range: is out of the allowed range
rule.mailbox: must be in the form Name <email>
rule.host_scheme: Enter the host only, without http:// or https://
rule.host_port: Don't include a port (e.g. :1234); Looklook decides the port
rule.host_path: Enter the host only; no /, spaces or similar characters
rule.host_ip: The IP address is incomplete or incorrect, e.g. 192.168.1.20
rule.host_unusable: This address can't be used to open a page (e.g. 0.0.0.0). Enter the machine's actual IP
rule.host_name: Invalid format: only letters, digits, hyphens and dots, e.g. nas.local
rule.ip_format: Invalid entry; use an IP, range or domain, e.g. 203.0.113.7, 203.0.113.0/24 or home.example.com
rule.ip_prefix: Invalid prefix length; IPv4 uses /8 to /32
rule.ip_too_wide: Range too wide; it can't be opened to the whole internet
rule.ip_loopback: This computer can already open it itself; no need to add
rule.ip_too_many: The allowlist holds at most 32 entries
rule.code_length: The access code must be 8 to 64 characters
rule.file_name: can’t be empty, contain / \ or other special characters, or be . or ..
rule.relative: must be a path inside the repository
rule.private_key: isn’t an OpenSSH / PEM private key (it should start with -----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----)
rule.ppk: is a PuTTY (.ppk) key — export it to OpenSSH format in PuTTYgen first
rule.jump_required: — “Via jump host” needs a jump host
rule.jump_loop: can’t lead back to this host

DEVICE_TIMEOUT: This computer didn't answer in time; retrying
CLIENT_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach Looklook on this computer; it may have quit
RTC_RELAY_UDP: Can't reach this computer: neither this browser nor the computer can reach the UDP ports of the current route, so they can only connect directly on the same local network. The relay server may not allow UDP (3478 and 49160–49999); try switching routes in Looklook on that computer
RTC_DEVICE_NO_ROUTE: Can't reach this computer: it can't reach the UDP port (3478) of the current route, so it can only connect directly on the same local network. Check whether a firewall or proxy on its network blocks UDP, or switch routes in Looklook on that computer
RTC_BROWSER_NO_ROUTE: Can't reach this computer: the network this browser is on can't reach the current route (port 3478 is blocked for both UDP and TCP). Try another network, or turn off any proxy that intercepts traffic, then retry
RTC_FAILED: Can't reach this computer: the connection between this browser and the computer could not be established; the network may be restricting UDP. Retry later, or switch routes in Looklook on that computer
REMOTE_FORBIDDEN: This action can only be done on this computer or the LAN
PORT_RESERVED: {{port}} is used by Looklook itself. Pick another number
WORKDIR_DENIED: No permission to use folder: {{path}}. Pick another folder or grant access to it
TTYD_MISSING: The installation is incomplete and the terminal component is missing. Please reinstall Looklook
NO_FREE_PORT: Too many terminals are running. Stop some first
NO_TMUX: The background-session component isn't available on this computer
OFFLINE_TOO_LONG: Haven't reached the Looklook server for a long time

reason.OFFLINE_TOO_LONG: haven't reached the Looklook server for a long time

INSTANCE_RUNNING: The terminal is still running. Stop it before deleting
ACCESS_CODE_REQUIRED: Enter the access code first (refresh the page to see the input box)
SHELL_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find the shell "{{shell}}" on this computer. Check the name or enter the full path.
UPDATE_BUSY: An update is already in progress.
UPDATE_NONE: You're already on the latest version.
UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED: This installation can't update itself. Download the new version from the download page.
UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Downloading the update failed. Check your network and try again. ({{detail}})
UPDATE_CHECKSUM: The downloaded file failed verification (possibly incomplete). Please try again.
UPDATE_FAILED: Installing the update failed; your current version is unchanged. ({{detail}})
AGENT_NOT_FOUND: This AI assistant wasn't found on this computer; install it first
MCP_DISABLED: Turn on "Allow AI assistants to add pages" first
DSH_EXISTS: DSH is already set up on this computer; open it from the terminal list
DSH_NEEDS_PERSISTENT: DSH needs terminals that keep running in the background, which this computer doesn't support
MODEL_DISCLAIMER_REQUIRED: Please read and accept the disclaimer first
MODEL_URL_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported endpoint: it must start with https:// and the path may only contain letters, digits and - . _ ~ /
MODEL_PROVIDER_GONE: This provider is no longer available for this client. Refresh and choose again.
FILE_EXISTS: A file or folder with that name already exists. Pick another name.
GIT_MISSING: Git isn’t installed on this computer. Install Git and try again.
GIT_NOT_REPO: This folder isn’t a Git repository.
GIT_TIMEOUT: git didn’t finish within {{seconds}} seconds and was stopped. Try running it in the terminal.
GIT_AUTH:
This needs a sign-in or password, which can’t be entered here. Run git once in the terminal to sign in (or set up credentials / an SSH key), then try again.
{{detail}}
BACKUP_IN_PROGRESS: Another backup is already running. Try again in a moment.
SSH_NAME_TAKEN: There’s already a host named “{{name}}”. Pick another name.
SSH_MISSING: No ssh command on this computer. Install the OpenSSH client first.
SSH_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: This host isn’t available to AI assistants.
SSH_JUMP_IN_USE: Other hosts connect through it ({{names}}). Give them another jump host or connect them directly first.
SSH_AI_DISABLED: SSH access for AI assistants is turned off (turn it on on the AI assistants page).
SSH_TRANSFER_NEED_RTC: Importing SSH hosts only uses a direct connection between the two computers (WebRTC), and right now they can only reach each other through a relay. Try another network.
SSH_TRANSFER_LOCAL_APPROVE: This can only be confirmed in Looklook opened on that computer itself (remote confirmation of SSH exports is off there).
SSH_TRANSFER_LOCAL_ONLY: “This computer only” is on, so Looklook won't connect to other computers. Turn it off in the computer menu first.
SSH_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED: That computer or the Looklook server is too old to import SSH hosts. Update Looklook on both computers first.
SSH_TRANSFER_PROTOCOL: Something went wrong between the two computers. Please start over.
SSH_TRANSFER_SIGNATURE: The other computer's identity check failed, so the import stopped.
SSH_TRANSFER_TAMPERED: The data received had been altered and was discarded. Nothing was imported.
SSH_TRANSFER_WRONG_DEVICE: You can't import from this computer itself.
SSH_TRANSFER_HOSTS: The selected hosts don't match (they may have just been changed on that computer). Please pick again.
SSH_TRANSFER_EXPIRED: This import expired (not finished within 5 minutes). Please start over.
SSH_TRANSFER_REPLAY: This import was already used. Please start over.
SSH_TRANSFER_BUSY: That computer already has an import waiting for confirmation. Finish it or wait for it to expire.
SSH_TRANSFER_STATE: This import can't do that right now. Refresh and check again.
SSH_TRANSFER_CODE_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes; this import was cancelled.
SSH_TRANSFER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Remote confirmation needs the email code.
SSH_TRANSFER_REJECTED: The import was rejected on that computer.
CHAT_UNAVAILABLE: The chat view isn't turned on for this terminal
CHAT_BUSY: Claude Code is waiting for your choice; finish that first
CHAT_SCREEN_CHANGED: Claude Code's screen changed; try again
CHAT_RUNNING: Claude is working. Switch after this turn finishes
CHAT_INPUT_NOT_EMPTY: Claude Code's input box has unsent text (maybe typed in another window); send or clear it, then try again
CHAT_MODE_UNAVAILABLE: This mode isn't available: this session was started without it. Restart the session (sessions started by the new version can switch to bypass permissions) and try again
CHAT_SEND_NOW_UNAVAILABLE: This Claude Code version doesn't have Send now (added in 2.1.275). Update Claude Code, or wait for the current step to finish
RESUME_NEEDS_PERSISTENT: Session persistence is off on this computer, so earlier conversations can't be continued
DOCKER_NOT_FOUND: The docker command was not found on this computer
CHAT_FOREIGN: The {{agent}} in the terminal wasn't opened by Looklook, so the chat view can't be used
CODEX_APP_SERVER: Couldn't reach the Codex background service. Please try again
CODEX_NOT_FOUND: Codex wasn't found. Make sure it's installed on this computer
CHAT_TERMINAL_ONLY: The chat can't reach Codex right now; use the terminal for now
CODEX_TERMINAL_BUSY: The program in the terminal didn't exit. Quit it in the terminal, then reconnect
CODEX_TERMINAL_STOPPED: The terminal isn't running. Start it first
SYNC_NEED_RTC: Settings sync only runs between computers over the end-to-end channel.
SYNC_SIGNATURE: The other computer's identity check failed, so nothing was synced.
SYNC_UNSUPPORTED: The Looklook server is too old to sync settings yet.
SYNC_DISABLED: That computer has settings sync turned off.
SYNC_PROTOCOL: The two computers run incompatible versions of Looklook. Update both to the latest version.
